title: Quarterly roadmap for Dedicated Capacity experiment lab and rollback playbook
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Objective: build a lightweight, repeatable quarterly experiment lab for Dedicated pools that validates autoscale guardrails, burst failover behavior, and cost/latency trade-offs, plus an ops-ready rollback playbook. Scope: 1) Define a matrix of controlled experiments (reservation granularity, warm pool thresholds, preemptive vs reactive scaling) that can run against sandboxes and one pilot customer pool. 2) Produce end-to-end runbooks: canary criteria, automated fallback rules, manual rollback steps, and incident checklist. 3) Integrate cost simulations with token-level telemetry to estimate $/1M tokens under each profile. 4) Teach ops and support via a rehearsal (chaos test) and tabletop. Out of scope: large-scale fleet re-architecture in this quarter; deep kernel-level runtime changes will be tracked as follow-ups. Success metrics: reproducible experiment runs, clear cost delta estimates, documented rollback paths with <=30min mean restore time in rehearsals, and a go/no-go decision template for production rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment matrix defined and reviewed by Eng + Research (matrix CSV attached in Confluence)
Pilot run completed against two dedicated pools with p95 latency, error rate, and cost deltas recorded
Rollback playbook documented and validated in a rehearsal with SRE (time-to-recover measured)
Dashboard with per-experiment telemetry and cost projection links available to PM/Eng/Support
A short postmortem and recommendation memo (go/no-go) are published in Confluence with next-step proposals
